name: Pirate Queen Theryn Kael'Vakar
role: Confederation Leader and Commanding Officer of the Khar'Thyrix
notes: Confederation leader and captain of the Khar'Thyrix (mobile fortress/refugee ship/black-market hub). Command authority tied to ship.

location_binding.basis: Office-holder binding. Canon establishes the office (Confederation Leader and Commanding Officer of the Khar'Thyrix, outer_colonies) but names no seat, vessel or world where this character is located. The Union capital is referenced only as 'the capital planet' (Marshal Academy charter) and has no location entity; no polity seat entities exist either.
location_binding.why_not_invented: Binding to an invented seat would fabricate a canonical place. C1 requires the one-body-one-place question to be ANSWERED; an explicit undetermined binding answers it honestly, the same way canonical_position_status: unplaced and route_exemption do.
location_binding.resolves_when: A seat-of-government / duty-station location is established in canon (queued as l2-seat-of-government-locations), at which point type/target_id are filled in.
